note: Generic, non-clinical signposting. Shown immediately whenever a safety trigger fires. Review with the mission's medical team before real use.

reasons.safety_item: You indicated thoughts of being better off dead or of hurting yourself. You do not have to handle this alone.
reasons.severe_symptom: You reported a severe physical symptom (sudden chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness). Get medical help right now.

resources: Contact your flight surgeon or your designated support contact now.
If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now.
If you can, stay with or reach out to someone you trust while you get support.
